query:
SELECT l.id, l.businessName, l.sellerId, l.status, l.isPublished, l.paymentStatus, l.tier, l.paidAt, l.createdAt, u.email
FROM listings l
JOIN users u ON l.sellerId = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'a@igacquire.com'
ORDER BY l.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
